# Cydnie Jocelyn

> Brand and business strategy partner for founders and leaders. Cydnie Jocelyn partners
> with businesses on brand identity, websites, operations and business development, and
> hosts small-group retreats for women. Operated by Cydnie Jocelyn LLC, a Minnesota company
> based in Forest Lake, working with clients remotely across the United States.

Cydnie Jocelyn Brown is a brand and business strategist and retreat host. She comes out of
business development. She is not a life coach, not a mindset coach, and this is not a
wellness brand. The work is brand strategy, operations, and business development, delivered
as a hands-on partnership rather than a one-off deliverable.

## Positioning

- Differentiator: a partner, not a vendor. One person across brand, operations and growth,
  who stays in the work after launch. "When you win, I win."
- Who it is for: founders, established businesses that are scaling, new businesses
  launching, and leaders building a personal brand, who want a partnership and understand
  it is priced as one.
- Published pricing: every starting price is on the site before anyone books a call.
- Working style: "I lead with heart and close with operations."

## Key facts

- Legal entity: Cydnie Jocelyn LLC (Minnesota). The only operating entity.
- Location: Forest Lake, Minnesota 55025, roughly thirty minutes north of Saint Paul.
- Areas served in person: Forest Lake, Blaine, Anoka, Ramsey, East Bethel, Lino Lakes,
  Hugo, Shoreview, White Bear Lake, Cambridge, Isanti, North Branch, Crosslake,
  Minneapolis, Saint Paul, and the wider Twin Cities metro. Anoka, Isanti, Washington and
  Chisago counties. Remote clients anywhere; retreats run in the United States and
  internationally. The same list is machine readable as `areaServed` on the LocalBusiness
  node in the head of every page.
- Travel arm: Jocelyn & Co. Travel, a DBA under Cydnie Jocelyn LLC, Independent Travel Agent
  with Atlas Coast Travel Group. Agency coverage does not extend to retreats.

## Offers

The container is standard; the contents are never the same twice. No package and no formula.

- A free 30 minute call. The front door: a conversation to see whether a partnership fits.
  Book at https://clients.cydniejocelyn.com/schedule/69f9f2a095c611cc2401eec7
- The Retreat. Several days in which nobody needs anything from the guest. Structured solitude
  inside a group capped at fifteen. No forced sharing.
- The Build. Brand, operations, and business development, scoped after listening, never before.
  Brand creation from nothing, operations, business development, or a combination.
  https://www.cydniejocelyn.com/the-build/

Pricing is published in full and no call is required to see a number.

- A Sounding, $300 flat. Ninety minutes, and a written page delivered two days later. No
  preparation, no intake form. The first paid step into any engagement below, and the $300
  comes off a Build. https://www.cydniejocelyn.com/a-sounding/
- The Build, one day, $1,500 flat. Audit and discovery, then positioning and message.
- The Build, a season, from $6,000. The same two phases, then operations and delivery, then
  growth direction and next work.
- Website, from $4,000. Designed and coded, responsive.
- Content, $3,600 per quarter. A defined quarter with a defined output.
- Full brand engagement, from $15,000. All of the above plus brand guide, identity including
  logo, and a launch plan. Identity and logo are not sold on their own at any price.

Retreat pricing is published in full on each retreat page. Every Build engagement is tailored
and the scope is written into a proposal before either party commits, so a starting figure is
a starting figure and not a quote.

## The Letters

A free weekly letter written by Cydnie the week it goes out, on what it costs to run a
business that depends entirely on its owner. It is not a newsletter and carries no offers.
Retreat dates and new work open to this list before they are published anywhere else, and
the fifteen seat cap means a retreat can fill from the list alone.
https://www.cydniejocelyn.com/the-letters/

## Retreats

All dates are listed at https://www.cydniejocelyn.com/retreats/

- Rise Into Her: The Greece Edition. August 13 to 20, 2027. Armonia Retreat Center, Douliana,
  Crete, Greece. 15 guests. $3,265 early rate through September 6 2026, $3,450 standard from
  September 7 2026, $500 non-refundable deposit. ALL FIFTEEN SEATS ARE TAKEN. The waitlist is
  open and is called in order when a seat opens; a seat that opens on or before September 6
  2026 is held at the early rate. Movement led by Kris Krause of Your Time Fitness LLC.
  Lodging, every meal, daily movement, all sessions and excursions and round trip ground
  transport from Chania (CHQ) are included. Airfare and travel insurance are not.
  Rooms are shared, two to a room, twin beds, each with an en-suite bathroom. There is no
  single occupancy option and no single supplement: one room type, one price.
  https://www.cydniejocelyn.com/retreats/greece/
- Wide Open: The Gatlinburg Edition, 13 to 18 April 2027, in a private house in Gatlinburg,
  Tennessee, at the edge of the Great Smoky Mountains. With Cydnie Jocelyn and Kayla Freeman.
  Lodging, every meal, daily movement, two workshops and two outings included. Shared room
  $1,490 and private king suite $2,790 at the early rate through 31 October 2026, then $1,600
  and $2,900. $500 deposit. Fly into Knoxville (TYS); airfare is not included.
  https://www.cydniejocelyn.com/retreats/gatlinburg/
- Private retreats are available by inquiry for an existing group, a team or a community. The
  price is a function of location and length, so it is the one thing on this site that is not
  published in advance.
- Retreat terms, published in full at https://www.cydniejocelyn.com/privacy-policy/#terms : every
  retreat is capped at fifteen guests, some are smaller, and a retreat requires a minimum of
  eight confirmed guests to run.
  A $500 non-refundable deposit reserves a space, and a space is reserved only when the deposit
  is received and a booking confirmation is issued; an inquiry form does not hold one. All
  retreat payments are non-refundable, including the deposit, for any reason. If Cydnie Jocelyn
  LLC cancels a retreat, guests receive retreat credit equal to everything paid, valid two
  years, not redeemable for cash. Travel insurance is strongly recommended and every guest
  completes a form either confirming coverage or declining it in writing.
- Rise & Reground: The Costa Rica Experience ran in April 2026 and is complete. Guest feedback
  is published on the retreats page as quotations, attributed. One guest, Melissa, recorded a
  video review, which is there too. No average score is published and none should be quoted:
  the response count is too small for an average to mean anything.

## Selected client work

Shown at https://www.cydniejocelyn.com/the-build/#work, captioned by the positioning decision
rather than the aesthetic.

- Mane Alchemist Salon, manealchemistsalon.com. Full build: logo, brand identity kit, website, social.
  Positioned away from the wellness salon default and toward deliberate luxury.
- SolyRey, solyrey.com. Logo, brand kit, website. The promise moved off the destination
  and onto the logistics being handled.
- SRS Performance, srsperform.com. Website for a Minneapolis performance training studio.
  Narrowed from general fitness to former competitive athletes.
- T Sharp and Alchemy with A. Brand voice and content engagements.

## What is refused

- No logo sold on its own. Identity comes after the positioning it carries.
- No retainer with no defined end. Every engagement has a last day written into it.
- No coaching. This is business development; the client gets a diagnosis and a plan.
- No promised number. No claim is made about what a client's revenue will do.

## Legal

Privacy policy and terms of use are one document at
https://www.cydniejocelyn.com/privacy-policy/ , the terms half at #terms. Cydnie Jocelyn LLC is a
Minnesota limited liability company; these terms are governed by Minnesota law and disputes go
to binding arbitration in Minnesota. Payments run through HoneyBook and email through Flodesk;
card details are never stored by Cydnie Jocelyn LLC. Nothing offered on the site is licensed
mental health care, medical, legal, tax or financial advice. Everything offered is for adults
eighteen and over.
